Settings.GridSnap.Title: Grid Snap
Settings.GridSnap.ShowGuides: Show Pin Alignment Guides during dragging
Settings.GridSnap.GuidesDescription: Displays cyan guide lines when component pins share an X or Y axis. The component snaps to alignment when released nearby.
Settings.Routing.Title: Routing
Settings.Routing.DiagonalDescription: Octile A* with 45° diagonals produces shorter, more compact routes, but every re-route needs considerably more compute. When disabled, the fast 4-direction (Manhattan) search is used. Toggling this re-routes all connections immediately.
Settings.Routing.CrossingDescription: After routing, replaces a detouring waveguide with a real PDK crossing component where that lowers insertion loss. Turn off for classic avoid-only routing — faster on large designs, and no crossings are inserted.
Settings.Updates.Title: Software Updates
Settings.GdsExport.Title: GDS Export
Settings.GdsExport.Description: Configures how the "Export" top-toolbar action generates a GDS file from the exported Nazca Python script. The gdsfactory export is a separate Export-menu entry; install gdsfactory below via "Install gdsfactory".
Settings.GdsExport.GenerateGds: Generate GDS file after Nazca export (Nazca export requires Python + Nazca; gdsfactory export requires gdsfactory)
Settings.GdsExport.PythonEnvDescription: The interpreter used to run the exported Nazca script is chosen in the Python Environments page — one place lists managed environments and discovered system Pythons with their Nazca and gdsfactory versions.
Settings.GdsExport.ManageTip: Open the Python Environments page to select or create an interpreter
Settings.Ai.Title: AI Assistant
Settings.Ai.Description: Configure the Anthropic Claude API key used by the AI Design Assistant in the right panel. The key is stored locally and never transmitted elsewhere.
Settings.ChipSize.Title: Chip Size
Settings.ChipSize.Description: Sets the physical footprint of the PIC chip. Components placed outside the boundary are flagged in Design Checks but not moved. Range: 0.25–100 mm per dimension.
Settings.Language.Title: Language
Settings.Language.Description: Choose the language of the user interface. "System" follows your operating system's display language; unsupported system languages fall back to English.
Settings.Language.RestartNote: Texts switch immediately. The Settings sidebar and some window titles update the next time they are opened. Exported files (GDS, Nazca, netlists) are never affected by the UI language.
